notes: Tap the typing bubble to stop a reply. The caption now ends with 'tap to stop' — one tap (and a confirm) aborts the request on the wire, halts the cold-start retries and budget extensions, stops a photo mid-poll, releases the generation queue, and clears the record so the stopped reply doesn't auto-resume on the next launch. Sending a new message after a stop works immediately. No more being held hostage by a wait you've already given up on.
